_comment: Single source of truth for the matched W1 parameters of B0, B1 and B2. Read by the Foundry tests (test/W1Base.sol) and by the live runner (experiments/workloads/w1/config.py). wei/token values are decimal strings. Changing any value after a result is reported requires a docs/decision-log.md entry.

fees._comment: One fee policy for every transaction and every UserOperation in every baseline. The runner pins each block's base fee to base_fee_per_gas, so the effective price is min(max_fee, base_fee + priority) = 2 gwei everywhere.

eoa_tx_gas_limits._comment: Fixed (not estimated) gas limits for plain transactions. b0_action is the recipient EOA's ERC-20 transfer; native_transfer_to_deployed_account is used only when ETH is sent to an already-deployed SimpleAccount (W1-warm), whose payable receive() runs through the ERC-1967 proxy and cannot fit in 21,000 gas; the sender's ETH allowance for B0 is exactly b0_action * max_fee_per_gas.

userop._comment: Identical account-side limits for B1, B2-Allowlist and B2-Signature, fixed before any reported result from calibration runs on 2026-09-14 (docs/decision-log.md): B1 validation (deploy + signature + prefund payment) needs between 200k and 250k gas and B2 validation under 200k, so 300k is one shared value with margin; account execution uses ~34k gas, and 60k stays within EntryPoint v0.9.0 PENALTY_GAS_THRESHOLD (40k) so no 10% unused-execution-gas penalty is charged (80k incurred a 4,601-gas penalty in both B1 and B2). B2 additionally carries a paymaster verification limit; its postOp limit is 0 because ObservablePaymaster has no postOp. preVerificationGas is NOT fixed: experiment runs use calibrated_overhead_v1 = 21,000 + calldata gas of the exact final bundle + the EntryPoint overhead from baselines/w1_b0_b2/calibration/pvg-overhead.json (produced by `python3 -m experiments.workloads.w1.calibrate`, which uses the break_even_calibration_v1 exact-bundle dry run); provisional_pre_verification_gas is only the starting value of that dry run and the value used by the Forge semantics tests. B1's native funding is exactly the EntryPoint required prefund with the calibrated value: (verification + call + preVerification) * max_fee_per_gas. Both B2 variants share the paymaster limits; B2-Signature signs validUntil/validAfter = 0/0 (no time bound).

funding._comment: Setup-phase ETH from the local faucet (anvil dev account 0). Not part of W1 workflow cost; recorded separately. The beneficiary is pre-funded so EntryPoint compensation never pays the one-time 25,000-gas new-account charge (a production bundler's beneficiary already exists). paymaster_deposit is made for each of the two paymasters.
